entry.title: Health Secretary Kennedy touts an initiative to study vaccine safety
entry.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has established a new clinic at the National Institutes of Health to study vaccine injuries. It's part of a larger administration effort on vaccine safety.

entry.title: Suicide is up among Black Americans. We need to talk about it.
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin hosted a panel conversation about mental health and suicide in the Black community, exploring a difficult subject in deeply personal conversations.

entry.title: Medical debt is crushing hospital patients in LA. Health officials may have a fix
entry.summary: In Los Angeles County, the nation's most populous, a new system could screen hospital patients for financial aid, preventing hundreds of thousands from getting bills they can't pay.

entry.title: New Maryland law requires radiologists inform patients of heart disease warning sign
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with radiologist Dr. Lisa Mullen about a new Maryland law requiring that patients be notified if mammogram results show calcium deposits in blood vessels.

entry.title: Republicans and Democrats find a unifying target: Pharmacy benefit managers
entry.summary: Republicans and Democrats, both patients and politicians, seem united in their disdain for the healthcare companies known as pharmacy benefit managers. Tennessee and Arkansas are regulating now them.

entry.title: The WHO seeks more details on the death of a plague research lab employee in Russia
entry.summary: The World Health Organization says it wants more information on what caused the death of an employee at a Russian plague research lab. Russia says the woman died of pneumonia of unknown origin.

entry.title: What is the pneumonic plague?
entry.summary: The ancient disease of plague is back in the headlines after the death this month of a Russian lab worker.

entry.title: Doomscrolling too much? Try these tips to put the phone down and plug into real life
entry.summary: NPR Life Kit provides tips to help you reduce your screentime.

entry.title: How to define a measles death
entry.summary: Historically, the CDC relied on state health departments' determination of measles deaths. Now, it's working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists to create a clear definition.

entry.title: She got Trump's $500 check for health insurance. To her, it's a 'political stunt'
entry.summary: As checks from President Trump for health costs hit millions of mailboxes, a poll shows Americans don't trust Republicans on healthcare. Experts doubt it will move the needle and say it is likely illegal.
